title: Omnipod Eros fails comm after 1d
symptom: Since moving to AAPS 3.2.0.4, Omnipod Eros pods fail communication earlier than 3 days, with error 'communication failed: nonce resume failed' when delivering insulin or changing temp basal.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Possible explanations discussed include excessive communication draining pod battery, low pod battery voltage, faulty pods, or architectural changes in AAPS 3.x, but none confirmed.
fix: No definitive fix is stated. Suggestions include switching the RL device off/on, restarting phone, re-registering RL, and reverting to old algorithm, but user reports these did not resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: I tried everything you mentioned for every pod that failed and nothing changed. Also, this issue didn't appear with the previous version of AAPS, 2.8.
